verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com that indexes the Mesh guides. Doc pages are served as raw markdown with an agentTools frontmatter pointing agents to that project index. An unauthenticated, parseable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema is also available for agents to consume. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining how to point agents at these resources (e.g. an llms-full.txt or an agent usage guide).
